title: Reverently
summary: REV'ERENTLY, adverb 1. With reverence; with respectful regard. Chide him for faults, and do it reverently 2. With veneration; with fear of what is great or terrifying. So reverently men quit the open

inlines.v: REV'ERENTLY, adverb 1. With reverence; with respectful regard. Chide him for faults, and do it reverently 2. With veneration; with fear of what is great or terrifying. So reverently men quit the open air, when thunder speaks the angry Gods abroad.
